programme.desc: Allison's life falls apart following her involvement in a fatal accident. She finds solace in an unexpected relationship with her would-be father-in-law. He becomes her ally in her journey to healing.

programme.title: A Good Person
programme.desc: Allison's life falls apart following her involvement in a fatal accident. She finds solace in an unexpected relationship with her would-be father-in-law. He becomes her ally in her journey to healing.

programme.title: Sex
programme.desc: Two married chimney sweeps find their lives unexpectedly shaken when one reveals a sexual encounter with a male client while the other is unsettled by recurring dreams in which he appears as a woman. Director Dag Johan Haugerud's acclaimed drama explores identity, desire and masculinity with humour and insight. Starring Jan Gunnar Røise and Thorbjørn Harr.

programme.title: Oskars Kleid
programme.desc: When Ben's son decides to live as a girl from now on, his world is turned upside down and the relationship with his family is put to a severe test.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: The Remains Of The Day
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins plays a devoted English butler reflecting on a lifetime of service, lost love, and loyalty as he realizes too late the cost of his blind duty.

programme.title: Sasquatch Sunset
programme.desc: A Sasquatch family roams the forests of Northern California for a year, navigating nature, survival, and encroaching human presence in this surreal, dialogue-free tale.

programme.title: The Life And Death Of Colonel Blimp
programme.desc: Considered to be one of the finest British films ever made, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp is a stirring masterpiece detailing the experiences of a British officer, Clive Candy (Roger Livesey), through the trials and tribulations of his army career from 1902 to 1942. Anton Walbrook and Deborah Kerr provide unforgettable support, he as a German enemy turned lifelong friend of Candy's and she as young women of three consecutive generations.

programme.title: The Cup
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this biographical film tells the story of two brothers as they compete for the highest honour in horse racing, The Melbourne Cup (2002), following the love and the triumph of the human spirit. Directed by Simon Wincer, stars Stephen Curry, Daniel MacPherson, Brendan Gleeson.

programme.title: Tony Takitani
programme.desc: A reclusive illustrator meets the love of his life, who happens to be a shop-a-holic. Directed and written by Jun Ichikawa and starring Issei Ogata, Rie Miyazawa and Shinohara Takahumi.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: A London cinema owner hides a deadly secret as part of a terrorist ring. When suspicion grows around him, his wife and a detective close in - unaware he's using her young brother to deliver bombs.

programme.title: The Lady in the Van
programme.desc: Alan Bennett's story is based on the true story of Miss Shepherd (Maggie Smith), a woman of uncertain origins who 'temporarily' parks her van in Bennett's London driveway and proceeds to live there for 15 years. What begins as a begrudging favour becomes a relationship that will change both their lives. Directed by Nicholas Hytner and also stars Alex Jennings, Jim Broadbent and Claire Foy.

programme.title: The Promised Land
programme.desc: Impoverished Captain Ludvig Kahlen tries to tame Denmark's brutal heath to earn a royal name, defying cruel landowner de Schinkel, who seeks revenge as Kahlen shelters runaways and protects his new family.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: In 18th century France, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont play a dangerous game of seduction.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary prepares indulgent side dishes that stand out next to a steak, like shrimp scampi stuffed potato, or stuffed mushrooms two ways.

programme.title: Mark Moriarty: Cook Like A Chef
programme.desc: Mark Moriarty is back with a new series and puts chicken centre stage, heading out to meet the producers raising it right before returning to the kitchen to show what one great bird can really do.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary teaches Anton Du Beke mouth-watering recipes, perfect for a total beginner.

programme.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: Joe Swash and The Batch Lady, Suzanne Mulholland, help the Brooks family in Falkirk tackle their mealtime chaos and show them tasty, nutritious meals that everyone will love.

programme.desc: Considered to be one of the finest British films ever made, The Life and Death of Colonel Blimp is a stirring masterpiece detailing the experiences of a British officer, Clive Candy (Roger Livesey), through the trials and tribulations of his army career from 1902 to 1942. Anton Walbrook and Deborah Kerr provide unforgettable support, he as a German enemy turned lifelong friend of Candy's and she as young women of three consecutive generations.

programme.title: The Cup
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this biographical film tells the story of two brothers as they compete for the highest honour in horse racing, The Melbourne Cup (2002), following the love and the triumph of the human spirit. Directed by Simon Wincer, stars Stephen Curry, Daniel MacPherson, Brendan Gleeson.

programme.title: Tony Takitani
programme.desc: A reclusive illustrator meets the love of his life, who happens to be a shop-a-holic. Directed and written by Jun Ichikawa and starring Issei Ogata, Rie Miyazawa and Shinohara Takahumi.

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: A London cinema owner hides a deadly secret as part of a terrorist ring. When suspicion grows around him, his wife and a detective close in - unaware he's using her young brother to deliver bombs.

programme.title: The Lady in the Van
programme.desc: Alan Bennett's story is based on the true story of Miss Shepherd (Maggie Smith), a woman of uncertain origins who 'temporarily' parks her van in Bennett's London driveway and proceeds to live there for 15 years. What begins as a begrudging favour becomes a relationship that will change both their lives. Directed by Nicholas Hytner and also stars Alex Jennings, Jim Broadbent and Claire Foy.

programme.title: The Promised Land
programme.desc: Impoverished Captain Ludvig Kahlen tries to tame Denmark's brutal heath to earn a royal name, defying cruel landowner de Schinkel, who seeks revenge as Kahlen shelters runaways and protects his new family.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: In 18th century France, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont play a dangerous game of seduction.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary prepares indulgent side dishes that stand out next to a steak, like shrimp scampi stuffed potato, or stuffed mushrooms two ways.

programme.title: Mark Moriarty: Cook Like A Chef
programme.desc: Mark Moriarty is back with a new series and puts chicken centre stage, heading out to meet the producers raising it right before returning to the kitchen to show what one great bird can really do.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary teaches Anton Du Beke mouth-watering recipes, perfect for a total beginner.

programme.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: Joe Swash and The Batch Lady, Suzanne Mulholland, help the Brooks family in Falkirk tackle their mealtime chaos and show them tasty, nutritious meals that everyone will love.

programme.sub-title: Chicken Kiev, Shepherd's Pie, Spaghetti Vongole

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern showcases the versatility of guinea hen, an often-overlooked game bird that offers richer flavor than commercial poultry.

programme.desc: The upper Midwest state is famous for its ‘cheese heads’ and proudly declares itself America’s Dairyland because it produces more cheese than any other state in the USA. programme.desc: Sophie explores how her Puglian neighbours eat and cook meat. She makes orecchiette pasta with meatballs, then visits her neighbour's countryside plot to cook pasta al forno and bombette.

programme.desc: Located in Sweden's south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment.

programme.desc: Nornie travels to Badu Island. With acclaimed artist Alick Tipoti, they prepare delicious dishes using fresh local ingredients.

Simon visits a sheep dairy to source a favourite cheese and then roams the coast in search of Samphire, a native herb.

programme.title: Nigella Kitchen

On the menu there are meltingly tender turkey meatballs in tomato sauce and a must-have party recipe, wholegrain mustard, and ginger cocktail sausages served in a scooped-out loaf. For something a little different, there is gorgeous grilled halloumi in radicchio leaves with a zingy beetroot and lime sauce. programme.title: The Cup
programme.desc: Based on a true story, this biographical film tells the story of two brothers as they compete for the highest honour in horse racing, The Melbourne Cup (2002), following the love and the triumph of the human spirit. Directed by Simon Wincer, stars Stephen Curry, Daniel MacPherson, Brendan Gleeson.

programme.title: Tony Takitani
programme.desc: A reclusive illustrator meets the love of his life, who happens to be a shop-a-holic. Directed and written by Jun Ichikawa and starring Issei Ogata, Rie Miyazawa and Shinohara Takahumi.

programme.title: Last Cab to Darwin
programme.desc: When Rex, a Broken Hill cab driver, is told he doesn't have long to live, he sets out on an epic journey to Darwin in a bid to die on his own terms.

programme.title: A Private Function
programme.desc: In the summer of 1947, Britain prepares to commemorate the wedding of Princess Elizabeth and Prince Phillip.

programme.title: Storm Boy
programme.desc: Mike is a lonely Australian boy living in a coastal wilderness with his reclusive father. In search of friendship, he encounters an Indigenous man estranged from his tribe, and the two form a bond in the care of three orphaned pelican chicks. Stars Peter Cummins, David Gulpilil and Greg Rowe.

programme.title: Eloise At The Plaza
programme.desc: Eloise is a fun-loving six year old girl with a knack for finding adventure every place she looks. While under the care of her “rather” wonderful Nanny (Julie Andrews), Eloise tries to play matchmaker to a lonely prince and wrangle an invitation to the society event of the season.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Spending the summer at a Catskills resort with her family, Frances "Baby" Houseman falls in love with the camp's dance instructor, Johnny Castle (Patrick Swayze).

programme.title: Sons
programme.desc: Idealistic prison officer Eva's sense of duty is tested when a young inmate connected to her past is transferred to her prison. Concealing her true motives, she requests reassignment to the facility's most dangerous unit and embarks on a risky quest that blurs the line between justice and revenge. Starring Sidse Babett Knudsen and Sebastian Bull.

programme.title: A Good Person
programme.desc: Allison's life falls apart following her involvement in a fatal accident. She finds solace in an unexpected relationship with her would-be father-in-law. He becomes her ally in her journey to healing.

programme.title: Sex

programme.title: Sabotage
programme.desc: A London cinema owner hides a deadly secret as part of a terrorist ring. When suspicion grows around him, his wife and a detective close in - unaware he's using her young brother to deliver bombs.

programme.title: The Lady in the Van
programme.desc: Alan Bennett's story is based on the true story of Miss Shepherd (Maggie Smith), a woman of uncertain origins who 'temporarily' parks her van in Bennett's London driveway and proceeds to live there for 15 years. What begins as a begrudging favour becomes a relationship that will change both their lives. Directed by Nicholas Hytner and also stars Alex Jennings, Jim Broadbent and Claire Foy.

programme.title: The Promised Land
programme.desc: Impoverished Captain Ludvig Kahlen tries to tame Denmark's brutal heath to earn a royal name, defying cruel landowner de Schinkel, who seeks revenge as Kahlen shelters runaways and protects his new family.

programme.title: Dangerous Liaisons
programme.desc: In 18th century France, the Marquise de Merteuil and the Vicomte de Valmont play a dangerous game of seduction.

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary prepares indulgent side dishes that stand out next to a steak, like shrimp scampi stuffed potato, or stuffed mushrooms two ways.

programme.title: Mark Moriarty: Cook Like A Chef
programme.desc: Mark Moriarty is back with a new series and puts chicken centre stage, heading out to meet the producers raising it right before returning to the kitchen to show what one great bird can really do.

programme.title: Mary Berry Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary teaches Anton Du Beke mouth-watering recipes, perfect for a total beginner.

programme.title: Batch From Scratch: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: Joe Swash and The Batch Lady, Suzanne Mulholland, help the Brooks family in Falkirk tackle their mealtime chaos and show them tasty, nutritious meals that everyone will love.

programme.title: Jamie's Comfort Food
programme.sub-title: Chicken Kiev, Shepherd's Pie, Spaghetti Vongole

programme.title: Poh & Co. Bitesize

programme.desc: Adam and his guests, globally acclaimed food writer Emiko Davies and hatted chef Alessandro Pavoni put the 'fun' in 'fungi' with a night of mouth-watering mushroom recipes.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Zimmern showcases the versatility of guinea hen, an often-overlooked game bird that offers richer flavor than commercial poultry.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: The upper Midwest state is famous for its ‘cheese heads’ and proudly declares itself America’s Dairyland because it produces more cheese than any other state in the USA. But since the 1950s, most of the original traditional cheese types have been replaced by bland and predictable mass-produced Swiss and Cheddar.

programme.title: Legends Of The Fork
programme.desc: Buddy sees what's between the bread at two old school joints that hold a special place in his heart.

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
programme.desc: Sophie explores how her Puglian neighbours eat and cook meat. She makes orecchiette pasta with meatballs, then visits her neighbour's countryside plot to cook pasta al forno and bombette.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Located in Sweden's south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment.

programme.title: Island Echoes With Nornie Bero
programme.desc: Nornie travels to Badu Island. With acclaimed artist Alick Tipoti, they prepare delicious dishes using fresh local ingredients.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
programme.desc: Amaretti biscuits take centre stage as Luca explores their sweet and savoury potential.

programme.title: Jamie At Home
programme.desc: Everyone loves potatoes. Jamie enthuses about these underground jewels and makes the perfect potato salad using freshly dug wonderful new potatoes at their best.

programme.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Kirsten Tibbals joins Justine on today's episode where she gives you a little history and a whole lot of deliciousness with her Paris Brest with Flaked Almonds and Raspberry and Cream Filling.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: Around fourteen kilometres off the coast of South Australia lies a beautiful and unspoilt piece of land. Kangaroo Island is five hundred and nine kilometres of stunning and dramatic coastline. It features beautiful beaches, is teeming with wildlife, and, as we discover, has become a source of delicious and innovative food produce. Simon visits a sheep dairy to source a favourite cheese and then roams the coast in search of Samphire, a native herb.

programme.title: Nigella Kitchen
programme.desc: It is Christmas, and Nigella is having a fabulous easy drinks party. On the menu there are meltingly tender turkey meatballs in tomato sauce and a must-have party recipe, wholegrain mustard, and ginger cocktail sausages served in a scooped-out loaf. For something a little different, there is gorgeous grilled halloumi in radicchio leaves with a zingy beetroot and lime sauce. Then as festive a dessert as you could imagine, squares of black beer gingerbread with snow-white icing sugar. For a final flourish, a simple, seasonal cocktail, Filthy Fizz.
